task_material.issue:
# Tuple defaults are not applied to omitted trailing items

Parsing a tuple with a trailing defaulted item returns an array that omits the defaulted value when the input stops before that position.

Reproduce with a two-item tuple whose second string schema has the default `fallback`, then parse `['present']`. The result should preserve `present` and materialize the defaulted second item.

candidate_information.text: The base version of `packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts` between lines 2635 and 2714 is relevant to this task.
In the base version, `$ZodTuple` supplies a value that `handleTupleResult` receives (call).
Parsing the two-item tuple [string, string.default('fallback')] with the one-item input ['present'] returns the one-item output ['present'] with length 1.
